name: [CAPE TOWN] Fish And Monsters!
desc:
Cast your line, explore the ocean, and collect rare fish with unique mutations. Sail across different islands, discover hidden treasures, complete quests, and take on exciting challenges to become a legendary fisher!

🍀 Collect from tons of unique fish variations
🎣 Fish with your friends
⛵ Sail the seas and explore new islands [10+ islands]
🐟 Catch rare and mutated fish [Over 250+ fish]
🦈 Join epic Sea Monster Raids
💰 Hunt for hidden treasures
📜 Complete quests & challenges
🎉 Weekly updates and special events

[HOW TO FISH]
• Click to charge up your cast
• Wait for a bite
• Click as fast as you can to reel it in
• Fill the progress bar to catch your fish

New content arrives every week, including limited fish, special events, new challenges, sea monster raids, treasure hunts, and more surprises from the sea.
The game is still new, if you see any bugs please let us know!

⭐ Remember to join the group and send feedback!

Grab your rod, sail out, and see what you can catch!
